faq_heading: Tsawwassen East houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Tsawwassen East sell for?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Tsawwassen East between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,595,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Tsawwassen East?
faq.a: The median was 41 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Tsawwassen East sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 14 houses that sold in Tsawwassen East went for between $1,433,750 and $1,715,725, around a median of $1,595,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Tsawwassen East sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 14 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.0% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Tsawwassen East?
faq.a: The median year built was 1980 for the 14 houses sold in Tsawwassen East.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Tsawwassen East usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Tsawwassen East had 4 bedrooms, from the 14 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Tsawwassen East houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

14 houses sold in Tsawwassen East with a median price of $1,595,000 (the middle half sold between $1,433,750 and $1,715,725), taking a median of 41 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $538 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 7,576 square feet.
How Tsawwassen East compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Tsawwassen East sold for $1,595,000, 6% above the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Tsawwassen East houses took a median 41 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
